name: GOCO Land Acquisition
summary: Grants of generally up to $3 million for fee-simple land acquisitions in Colorado that protect wildlife habitat, migration corridors and waterways while providing public access; land conservation organisations can apply alongside local governments.

steps: Contact regional officer and develop a concept

eligibility.rule: Not acquire property through condemnation or threat of condemnation
Exclude acquisition costs for existing buildings or structures and project contingency
Acquired land will not be owned and managed by a federal agency

applicant_types.quote: Organizations eligible for GOCO funding include Colorado cities, towns, and counties; Title 32 special districts; land conservation organizations that advance the acquisition of open space;

geography.quote: Organizations eligible for GOCO funding include Colorado cities, towns, and counties

access.quote: Ready to get started? Start by contacting your regional officer, who will help you develop a competitive proposal.

window.quote: First Cycle Concept papers due: July 23, 2026 Applications invited: August 7, 2026 Applications due: September 10, 2026 Grants awarded: December 11, 2026

amount.quote: Generally, up to $3 million per project.

co_finance_required.quote: GOCO does not have a minimum match requirement.

effort.quote: Contact your regional officer and develop a concept (6+ months before concept paper deadline).

eligibility.quote: GOCO cannot participate in property acquisitions involving condemnation or the threat of condemnation.
Acquisition costs associated with existing buildings and other structures • Project contingency
GOCO funds cannot be used for the acquisition of property to be owned and managed by a federal agency

after_award.quote: Submit final documentation for funding reimbursement.
